scope: Offline asset/package and sampled conservative geometry fit only

checks.detail: Pinned external bus package, original doors, animated leaf frames, metre datum, +Z front and nonboarding LOD2 preserved.
Distinct left driver cabinet, unseated right wheelhouse, three inward priority seats, three stowed places and four forward low-floor seats; actual GLB dark navy PBR material verified.
Actual triangle/index and bytes, 13 material batches per LOD, one measured embedded floor tile, no exported QA lights/cameras.
Count derives from real seat nodes; actual cushion width/height and independent head envelopes validated.

0.50 m square body envelope, 0.15 m centreline samples; 1.95 m low-floor standing and separate conservative 1.50 m seated wheelchair envelope. Raised rear is seated-only and never exposed as a standing anchor.
Both low-floor portals and lateral entry paths fit 1.95 m / radius 0.25 m reference in both LODs.
Actual legacy animated door GLBs at declared open transforms preserve both portals, sampled at 12 points each and in each LOD.

Every upward floor/step triangle is coplanar with its declared datum; dense vertical-ray grids and both continuous portal-to-aisle thresholds agree within 0.02 mm. Decorative ramp/edge overlays are not navigation support surfaces.

Final GLB SHA bound to sidecar, sidecar SHA bound to manifest, exact batch set, complete nonoverlapping vertex/index coverage, no escaping indices, actual bounds, unique node names, identity baked batch world transforms.
Exact semantic anchor set and full transformed positions/matrices compared to detailed master; no duplicate/missing/extra anchors, yaw drift or camera drift.
Quality tier is deliberately separate. Actual measured costs and overruns are recorded; original 12000/1.5 MiB and 3000/384 KiB validators and fallback remain unchanged.

Frame, doors, original four floor slabs, seat/pelvis/camera and inward-facing layout preserved. Both threshold supports retained. New surface topology and layered window/ceiling hardware measured independently; original master/fallback unchanged.

knownLimitations: Not a fleet-identical or survey-derived TransLink replica.
Both quality LODs exceed the original B-CAB triangle and byte budgets. Selective retessellation and UV compaction are complete; runtime/GPU suitability is not established.
Three right-side folding places are static stowed geometry, not active seats or deployed seat animation.
Rear deck has 1.92 m headroom and is seated-only; no rear standing anchor is exposed.

This quality derivative includes flush support strips to X=-1.25 m. Actual floor/step/threshold triangles and continuous joins are checked separately; these static samples do not certify walking animation.
These samples do not establish continuous runtime navigation, accessibility certification, GPU performance or boarding behavior.
